paite: "TOUPA'N Jakobte tung ah zahngaihna anei ding a, Israelte tel in amau gam ngeingei ah a-omsak ding hi; huan, gamdang mite'n amau azui ding ua, Jakob inkuanpihte alenkip ding uhi.
heading: Saltanna A Kipan A Kik Nawnna
english: For Yahweh will have compassion on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land. The foreigner will join himself with them, and they will unite with the house of Jacob.

paite: Huchi in michih in amau api ding ua, amun ding uh atun ding uhi; huchi in Israel inkuanpihte'n TOUPA gam ah amau salpa leh salnu in anei ding ua; amau sal a nei mite sal in ahon man ding ua; amaute simmohte tung ah vai ahon hawm ding uhi.
english: The peoples will take them, and bring them to their place. The house of Israel will possess them in Yahweh’s land for servants and for handmaids. They will take as captives those whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.

paite: "Huan na lungkhamna a kipan, na buaina a kipan leh nasep haksa pipi ahon sepsakna ua kipan in TOUPA'N nang ahon khawlsak ni chiang in hichi ahi ding hi.
heading: Sihna Khovel A Babulon Kumpipa
english: It will happen in the day that Yahweh will give you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard service in which you were made to serve,

paite: Hiai pau-el thu Babulon kumpipa kikoukhum in na gen ding. Bangchidan ahia, simmoh hatpa daita na e! Bangchidan ahia, dangka-eng khopi daita na tel e!
english: that you will take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, “How the oppressor has ceased! The golden city has ceased!”

paite: TOUPA'N migilou-salou chiangkhun ahihtanta, vaihawmte lalchiang.
english: Yahweh has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,

paite: Michih heh kawm a vo zialzial zel, thangpai kawm a kuamah kham ngei louh sawina a namte vai hawmsak zel.
english: who struck the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, who ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that none restrained.

paite: Lei pumpi akhawl a, adai vungvung a; thakhat in la asakhe guih uh.
english: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet. They break out song.

paite: Ahi, na tungthu ziak in meilahte anuam ua, Lebanon tang a sidar singte toh. Hihniam a na om nungsiah phukpaitu ding himhim ka kiang uah ahong tou ngei nawn kei uh," chi in.
english: Yes, the fir trees rejoice with you, with the cedars of Lebanon, saying, “Since you are humbled, no lumberjack has come up against us.”

paite: "Nuailam a kipan Sheol nang hon dawn ding in, nangmah ziak in abuai lutlut hi; misi, lei a makai tengteng nangmah ziak in atokthou a; namte kumpipa tengteng alaltutphah ua kipan akaidinghta hi.
english: Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. from beneath has moved for you to meet you at your coming. It stirs up the dead for you, even all the rulers of the earth. It has raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.

paite: Huai tengteng in nangmah bia in, na kiang ah huchi in agen ding uh. Nang leng kou bang a hat lou na hita maw?
english: They all will answer and ask you, “Have you also become as weak as we are? Have you become like us?”

paite: Na thupi mahmahna Sheol a pikhiaksuk ahita, na kaihging lunglungte toh; tangtel na nuai ah aphah ua, than in nang ahon khuhta uhi,” chi in.
english: Your pomp is brought down to Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. , with the sound of your stringed instruments. Maggots are spread out under you, and worms cover you.

paite: "Sun Aksi aw, Zingsang lam tapa, bangchidan ahia van a kipan na kiak tak maimah! Namte hihpukpa, bangchidan ahia lei a satkhiaksuk a na om maimah!
english: How you have fallen from heaven, morning star, son of the dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, who laid the nations low!

paite: Na lungtang in, van ah ka kah ding a, Pathian aksite tunglam ah ka laltutphah ka tawisang ding; huan, kikhopna tang, mal tawp a om ah, ka tu ding a;
english: You said in your heart, “I will ascend into heaven! I will exalt my throne above the stars of God! I will sit on the mountain of assembly, in the far north!

paite: meipi sang a sang ah ka kah ding a; Tungnungpen bang mai in ka om ding, na chi nak vial a.
english: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds! I will make myself like the Most High!”

paite: Himahleh, Sheol ah, kokhuk tawp ah, pikhiaksuk a om ding na hi ngal a.
english: Yet you shall be brought down to Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. , to the depths of the pit.

paite: "Ahon mu peuh in ahon lim-et ding ua, hiai mi maw lei hihling a, gam chih kisingsak a,
english: Those who see you will stare at you. They will ponder you, saying, “Is this the man who made the earth to tremble, who shook kingdoms;

paite: Khovel gamdai bang a bawl a, akhua omte hihmang a, asalte a-inn lam ua pai dia pawtsak ngei lou? chi in na tanchin asut ding uhi.
english: who made the world like a wilderness, and overthrew its cities; who didn’t release his prisoners to their home?”

paite: "Namte kumpipa tengteng, avek un, amau inn chiat uah thupitak in a-ihmu uh.
english: All the kings of the nations, sleep in glory, everyone in his own house.

paite: Nang bel ahun lou a piang kihhuaitak bang in leh gal thah, namsau a sut pailet, kokhuk a thante lak a paisukte puansilh bang in na han a kipan gamlapi ah paihkhiak in na om zawta hi; luang sikden bang mai in.
english: But you are cast away from your tomb like an abominable branch, clothed with the slain, who are thrust through with the sword, who go down to the stones of the pit; like a dead body trodden under foot.

paite: Na gam na hihsiat a, na khua na tuite na thah ziak in alak ua vui in nang zaw na om kei ding hi. Thil hoih lou hih mite suante min tangtawn in alou ngei kei ding uh.
english: You will not join them in burial, because you have destroyed your land. You have killed your people. The seed of evildoers will not be named forever.

paite: Akisak ua, lei aneih ua, leitung khopi a adimsaklouhna ding un, apipute uh khelhna ziak in atate uh thah ding ngaihtuah un," chi in.
english: Prepare for slaughter of his children because of the iniquity of their fathers, that they not rise up and possess the earth, and fill the surface of the world with cities.

paite: Huan "Amaute sual ding in ka kisa ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi, Babulon a kipan min leh akhosuaksunte leh tapa leh tapa' tapa ka hihmang ding, TOUPA'N achi.
heading: Pathian In Babulon Ahihse Ding
english: “I will rise up against them,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and son and son’s son,” says Yahweh.

paite: Sakuh a ding in gou in ka bawl ding a, dilte ah leng ka bawl ding; hihmanna munphiah in ka phiat lai ding," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: “I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water. I will sweep it with the broom of destruction,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichibang a gen in akichiamta, "Pel lou in ka ngaihtuah bangtak in ahong tung ding; ka seh bangtak in leng a-om ding.
heading: Pathian In Assuria Ahihse Ding
english: Yahweh of Armies has sworn, saying, “Surely, as I have thought, so shall it happen; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:

paite: Ka gam ah Assuria mi ka hihse ding a, ka tangte ah ka chil-ek ding achih bang in; huai hun chiang in ahakkol uh amau a kipan amangta ding a, apuakgik uh aliangzang ua kipan in amang sam ding hi.
english: that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and tread him under foot on my mountains. Then his yoke will leave them, and his burden leave their shoulders.

paite: Huai ahi, leitung pumpi a thuseh, huai mah ahi, nam chih tung a khut zak.
english: This is the plan that is determined for the whole earth. This is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations.

paite: Sepaihte' ToUPA'N asepta ngal a, kua'n asut dia? Akhut zak in a-omta, kua'n alaksak nawn dia?" chi in.
english: For Yahweh of Armies has planned, and who can stop it? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?”

paite: Kumpipa Ahaz sih kum in hiai puakgik ahong omta.
heading: Pathian In Philistiate Ahihse Ding
english: This burden was in the year that king Ahaz died.

paite: Philistia gam pumpi aw, nangmah vuakna chiang akitan tak ziak in kipak ke'n; gul zung a kipan in guldekpak apawt ding a, agah gul kuang leng thei ahong hi ding hi.
english: Don’t rejoice, O Philistia, all of you, because the rod that struck you is broken; for out of the serpent’s root an adder will emerge, and his fruit will be a fiery flying serpent.

paite: Migenthei ta masate'n ane un ata ding ua, mitagahte leng bittak in a-om ding uh; nang a zung bel kial in ka that ding a, nang akhosuaksunte thah in a-om ding uh.
english: The firstborn of the poor will eat, and the needy will lie down in safety; and I will kill your root with famine, and your remnant will be killed.

paite: Kongkhak aw, mau tuaituai in; khopi aw, kikou in; Philistia aw, na pum in na zulmang khinta; mallam a kipan in lah meikhu ahong pawt ngal a, ahun seh uah tuantual himhim a-om ngei kei uhi.
english: Howl, gate! Cry, city! You are melted away, Philistia, all of you; for smoke comes out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks.

paite: Philistia nam palaite bangchibang in i dawng ding ua? TOUPA'N Zion lah atungding a, amite lak a gentheite'n bitna amu uh, i chi ding uhi.
english: What will they answer the messengers of the nation? That Yahweh has founded Zion, and in her the afflicted of his people will take refuge.
